summary: You need CSRE 100, two of CSRE 101A, 101B and 101C, CHILATST 100, one Methodology course of 3 or more units, a Community-Engaged Learning course (it can also count elsewhere), and CSRE 200X or 201X for both the WIM and the capstone. The rest of the 60 units are CHILATST electives, plus up to 8 units of AFRICAAM, ASNAMST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses and up to 5 units of advanced Spanish. The core, Methodology, CEL, WIM, capstone and honors courses must be letter graded with a C- or better (unless a course is only offered S/NC); electives need a passing grade. You check by hand that no more than two elective classes are S/NC, petitioned courses not listed under CCSRE (at most 15 units), the 15 units of advanced Spanish behind the 5 you count, a CEL fellowship or Alternative Spring Break, and for honors the proposal, the 3.7 major and 3.5 overall GPA and the B+ thesis grade.

uuboTnPp.why: "The CEL requirement may be fulfilled by courses that also fulfill other Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies degree requirements (e.g., a Methodology course may also count toward the CEL requirement)." A fellowship or Alternative Spring Break, which carries no units, is marked done by the student. wf9XLpn3.why: "Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies majors must complete the remaining units of their 60-unit minimum with elective coursework in Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies. Exceptions are listed below." The remaining units depend on the core courses taken, so this rule takes every CHILATST elective and the Bulletin's 60-unit minimum checks the total. The exceptions are rule ov-other-units and the Language Study rule (urFSmBZd). Grading: "Additional units toward the major require a passing grade of D- or above. Student may count 2 classes with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units": electives need no letter grade here, and the two-class S/NC limit is checked by hand.

urFSmBZd.why: "Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies majors may count up to 5 units of advanced study of a Spanish language" and "If students complete 15 or more units of advanced (second-year or beyond) Spanish language study, they may apply 5 of those units toward their Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies major." Capped at 5 units; the 15-unit precondition is not checked.

limits.label: DAAAS, ASNAMST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses

add.why: "Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies majors may count up to 8 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), Jewish Studies (JEWISHST), or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) courses toward their degree in Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies." Optional: these units count toward the 60 but are not required. DAAAS courses carry the AFRICAAM subject code. The CSRE senior project and honors seminars (CSRE 200X, 201X, 201Y, 201Z) are the WIM, capstone and honors courses, not electives: electives are "the remaining units of their 60-unit minimum", after the core curriculum that includes the WIM and Capstone.
